free_tier.stated: 500 MB storage and 5 GB pull traffic per month: 'Amount of storage for images | 500 MB | Unlimited', 'Pull traffic | 5 GB per month | Unlimited' (Free vs Standard). Free-plan allowance confirmed in the quota doc: 'The free tier allowance for storage is 512 MB and traffic is 5120 MB.'

egress.terms: Pull traffic is metered as a quota, not priced per GB on the free plan: 'Pull traffic across public connections counts toward usage and quota. Pull traffic across private connections doesn't count.' Exceed it and access stops — 'If you exceed your storage or pull traffic limits, you cannot push or pull images to and from your namespace.'

tooling: ibmcloud cr CLI, docker/skopeo. OCI distribution spec compliant.
chaining: None — 512 MB is per IBM Cloud account and the overage behaviour is a hard stop, not a bill.

limits.value: traffic | 5 GB per month | Unlimited' (Free vs Standard)

limits_note: 512 MB storage, 5 GB pull traffic per month, per account across all namespaces in a registry instance; overage blocks push and pull entirely.
reliability_note: Hard cutoff on quota rather than overage billing, so a bulk workload simply stops mid-transfer.
